summary_of_pdf: This instrument is a facsimile transmission confirmation report generated by Fax.Plus, evidencing the successful delivery of a three-page document on April 6, 2026, from a Washington, D.C. area code (202) to a Houston, Texas area code (713). attorneys_comments: From an evidentiary standpoint, this confirmation report serves as foundational proof of delivery and notice, satisfying the threshold authentication requirements under Federal Rule of Evidence 901. The transmission from a Washington, D.C. origin to a Houston, Texas destination suggests communication likely bridging federal administrative or appellate counsel and local SDTX counsel or parties. While the report conclusively establishes the date, time, and successful transmission of three pages, it inherently lacks independent verification of the substantive contents transmitted. In practice before the Southern District of Texas, such documentation is routinely appended to declarations of service to rebut any presumption of non-receipt. Counsel must ensure this record is inextricably linked to the substantive three-page enclosure to maintain its probative value and avoid hearsay or authentication objections during motion practice.
